{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Hypnotizing Colored Mushrooms
| Image = Event-Mushrooms.png
}} {{Small Relic Infobox|Odd Mushroom}} {{Small Card Infobox|Parasite}}
{{E|Hypnotizing Colored Mushrooms}} is an [[Event]] encountered exclusively in [[Act 1]]. It will only appear if the player is on floor 7 or above. This Event is the only way to obtain {{R|Odd Mushroom}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Stomp}} {{TS|negative||Anger the Mushrooms.}}<br>
* Enter a battle against 3 {{M|Fungi Beast|Fungi Beasts}}. Winning grants the exclusive [[Relic]] {{R|Odd Mushroom}} along with regular combat rewards.
<br>
{{Frame|Eat}} {{TS|positive||Heal X HP.}} {{TS|negative||Become Cursed -}} {{C|Parasite}}{{TS|negative||.}}
* X is equal to 25% of the player's max HP.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You enter a corridor full of {{TS|blue|up|hypnotizing colored mushrooms.}}
<br>
Due to your lack of specialization in mycology you are unable to identify the specimens.
<br>
You want to escape, but feel oddly compelled to eat a {{TS|blue|up|mushroom...}}
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Stomp}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
{{TS|negative|shake|Ambushed!!}}
<br>
Rodents infested by the mushrooms appear out of nowhere!
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Eat}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You give in to the unnatural desire to eat. As you consume mushroom after mushroom, you feel yourself entering into a daze and pass out. As you awake, you feel very odd. You {{TS|green||Heal}} {{TS|blue||25%}} of your HP, but you also get {{TS|negative||infected.}}
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>
